title: Feature Request: Add lower back as a pump site
symptom: AAPS currently offers a limited set of pump site locations, but there is a big difference between the buttocks and the lower back. Absorption is delayed significantly in the former but not with the latter. The user wants to be able to choose and identify both locations.
fix: The issue was resolved by a pull request, as indicated by the comment 'See PR #4876 😉'.
